text: Coolant loop restart
This runbook restarts the coolant loop of the relay after a planned stop. Every step is performed by the operator on shift.
Step 1. Close the intake valve V-41 and confirm that the pressure gauge reads below 3 bar before continuing.
Step 2. Drain the reservoir into the holding tank through drain line D-2 and watch the level indicator.
warning: Drain only when the loop temperature is under 40 degrees; hot coolant flashes to steam and scalds the operator.

text: Step 3. Replace the particulate filter cartridge in housing F-7, then tighten the clamp by hand.
Warning: The housing stays pressurised for 90 seconds after the pump stops. Wait that long before opening the clamp of the filter housing.
Step 4. Open the intake valve slowly and bleed air at the top vent until the coolant runs clear without bubbles.
Step 5. Record the restart in the relay journal together with the final gauge reading and the cartridge serial.
Rollback
If the loop does not reach working pressure within ten minutes, close the intake valve again and open an incident report.
Relay antenna alignment
Align the north antenna of the relay mast after a storm or whenever the signal margin drops below the floor.
Step 1. Lock the mast brake and attach the safety line to the harness anchor before climbing the ladder.
warning: Never climb the mast while the transmitter is powered; the radiated field burns skin within seconds.

text: Step 2. Loosen the azimuth bolts a quarter turn and rotate the dish until the signal meter peaks.
warning: Keep one hand on the mast rail while the dish rotates.

text: Warning: A loose azimuth bolt lets the dish swing in the wind; check both bolts before leaving the platform.
Step 3. Tighten the azimuth bolts and the elevation bolts with the torque wrench at the marked value.
Warning: An over-torqued elevation bolt cracks the bracket; stop at the first click of the wrench.
Step 4. Release the mast brake, climb down and log the new signal margin in the relay journal.
Incident report: relay outage
The relay lost uplink for forty minutes during the night shift. The generator transfer switch had tripped on a voltage dip.
Root cause: the transfer switch threshold was left at the factory default after the generator service. Action: set the threshold per the generator runbook.
